notesStmt.note: Whitman has written "June 1889" at the top of this proof, and it is likely that that is when the proof was printed.
A proof of the poem "Twilight," with notes in ink and pencil, printed on a piece of birch bark. The poem was first published in Century Illustrated magazine in December 1887.
